remarks:
A Peace of Paradise nestled on nearly 6 acres of glorious grounds, complete with an in-ground pool and gorgeous spaces designed for hosting family and friends.

Guests are welcomed by a private driveway, custom gate, and a picturesque pond with a spectacular fountain. A charming front porch sets the tone for this Classic Colonial, filled with sun-drenched rooms and fabulous fixtures and finishes.

The first floor showcases an elegant entranceway and staircase, a formal dining room, and a chef’s kitchen featuring an island, granite counters, and abundant cabinetry. The large family room offers a stunning fireplace and generous space for gatherings or simply unwinding at the end of the day. The sensational sunroom provides sweeping views of the breathtaking yard, and a pretty powder room completes the main level.

Upstairs, the second floor boasts all nicely sized bedrooms. The stunning owner’s suite includes a spa-like bathroom and a wonderful custom walk-in closet. A convenient second-floor laundry adds ease to everyday living.

The basement provides endless possibilities for work, study, and play. A three-car garage plus a finished second floor offers even more flexibility — ideal for a private office, game room, or potential in-law quarters.

With neutral décor, an open floor plan, patios perfect for al-fresco dining, and scenic views from every room, this heavenly home is truly a must-see.  I'd like to Welcome you to your home! Some photos have been virtually staged.
